problem.title: Telehealth Visits Requiring Provider Follow-Up
problem.prompt: You work for a telehealth platform tracking visit completion. Write a function `visits_needing_followup` that takes two parameters: `p_specialty VARCHAR(50)` and `p_min_wait_minutes INTEGER`, and returns a table with columns `(visit_id INTEGER, patient_mrn VARCHAR(20), provider_npi VARCHAR(10), wait_minutes INTEGER, diagnosis_code VARCHAR(10))`. The function should return all visits where: (1) the provider specialty matches `p_specialty`, (2) the wait time from booking to video start is at least `p_min_wait_minutes`, (3) the video was completed (video_end_time is not NULL), and (4) the provider has NOT yet signed off (signoff_time is NULL). Order results by wait_minutes descending, then by visit_id ascending. The schema is modeled on CMS telehealth tracking datasets, using NPI (National Provider Identifier) and ICD-10 diagnosis codes. Test your function by calling: `SELECT * FROM visits_needing_followup('Psychiatry', 20);`
problem.schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE visits (visit_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, patient_mrn VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, booking_time TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, video_start_time TIMESTAMP, video_end_time TIMESTAMP, signoff_time TIMESTAMP, diagnosis_code VARCHAR(10)); CREATE TABLE providers (provider_npi VARCHAR(10) PRIMARY KEY, specialty VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE visit_assignments (visit_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES visits(visit_id), provider_npi VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL REFERENCES providers(provider_npi), PRIMARY KEY (visit_id, provider_npi));

composite_moves: JOIN visits with visit_assignments and providers
FILTER on specialty, wait_minutes, video_end_time NOT NULL, signoff_time NULL
CALCULATE wait_minutes using EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (video_start_time - booking_time))/60
ORDER BY wait_minutes DESC, visit_id ASC

hints: You'll need to join three tables to connect visits with their assigned provider's specialty.
Calculate the wait time in minutes by finding the difference between video_start_time and booking_time, then use EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ...) / 60 to convert to minutes.

Filter for visits where video_end_time is not NULL (completed) AND signoff_time is NULL (not signed off), and where the calculated wait time meets the minimum threshold and the specialty matches the parameter.
problem.answer_key:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION visits_needing_followup(p_specialty VARCHAR(50), p_min_wait_minutes INTEGER)
RETURNS TABLE (
  visit_id INTEGER,
  patient_mrn VARCHAR(20),
  provider_npi VARCHAR(10),
  wait_minutes INTEGER,
  diagnosis_code VARCHAR(10)
)
AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY (
    SELECT 
      v.visit_id,
      v.patient_mrn,
      va.provider_npi,
      CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (v.video_start_time - v.booking_time)) / 60 AS INTEGER) AS wait_minutes,
      v.diagnosis_code
    FROM visits v
    INNER JOIN visit_assignments va ON v.visit_id = va.visit_id
    INNER JOIN providers p ON va.provider_npi = p.provider_npi
    WHERE p.specialty = p_specialty
      AND v.video_end_time IS NOT NULL
      AND v.signoff_time IS NULL
      AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (v.video_start_time - v.booking_time)) / 60 >= p_min_wait_minutes
    ORDER BY wait_minutes DESC, v.visit_id ASC
  );
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

SELECT * FROM visits_needing_followup('Psychiatry', 20);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION visits_needing_followup(p_specialty VARCHAR, p_min_wait_minutes INTEGER)
RETURNS TABLE (visit_id INTEGER, 
               patient_mrn VARCHAR,
               provider_npi VARCHAR,
               wait_minutes INTEGER, 
               diagnosis_code VARCHAR) AS $$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY ( 
            SELECT
                va.visit_id,	
                v.patient_mrn,	
                p.provider_npi,	
                (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (v.video_start_time::timestamp - v.booking_time::timestamp)) / 60)::INT AS wait_minutes,	
                v.diagnosis_code
            FROM providers AS p
            JOIN visit_assignments AS va
                ON p.provider_npi = va.provider_npi
            JOIN visits AS v
                ON v.visit_id = va.visit_id
            WHERE p.specialty = p_specialty
                AND (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (v.video_start_time::timestamp - v.booking_time::timestamp)) / 60)::INT >= p_min_wait_minutes
                AND video_end_time IS NOT NULL
                AND v.signoff_time IS NULL
            ORDER BY wait_minutes DESC, visit_id
            );
END;
$$ LANGUAGE PLPGSQL;

SELECT * FROM visits_needing_followup('Psychiatry', 20);
